params.name: steps

default.title: The register
default.say: Every client of the firm, one row each, for the assessment year picked at the top: return form, a 3CD tag when the year is audited, and its stage.

default.title: Pick the year
default.say: Change the assessment year here. A client not yet in that year says so; open it and press Add to carry the master into the year.

default.title: A new client, once
default.say: New client opens the master: name, status, PAN, contacts, GSTIN, banks and partners for a firm. The PAN's 4th letter must match the status and a GSTIN must carry the PAN, so a slip is caught here.

default.title: Statements
default.say: Statements on a row opens Intake & map for that client and year, where the Excel files go.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
